credit_packs_exact_values.name: credit_packs_exact_values
credit_packs_exact_values.value: ("credit_packs"."id" = 'creator' AND "credit_packs"."credits" = 1900 AND "credit_packs"."subtotal_usd_cents" = 1900) OR ("credit_packs"."id" = 'pro' AND "credit_packs"."credits" = 4900 AND "credit_packs"."subtotal_usd_cents" = 4900) OR ("credit_packs"."id" = 'studio' AND "credit_packs"."credits" = 9900 AND "credit_packs"."subtotal_usd_cents" = 9900)

model_prices_nonnegative.name: model_prices_nonnegative
model_prices_nonnegative.value: ("model_prices"."input_nano_usd_per_token" IS NULL OR "model_prices"."input_nano_usd_per_token" >= 0) AND ("model_prices"."output_nano_usd_per_token" IS NULL OR "model_prices"."output_nano_usd_per_token" >= 0) AND ("model_prices"."operation_nano_usd" IS NULL OR "model_prices"."operation_nano_usd" >= 0)

payments_amounts_nonnegative.name: payments_amounts_nonnegative
payments_amounts_nonnegative.value: "payments"."subtotal_usd_cents" >= 0 AND ("payments"."tax_usd_cents" IS NULL OR "payments"."tax_usd_cents" >= 0) AND ("payments"."total_usd_cents" IS NULL OR "payments"."total_usd_cents" >= 0)

purchases_exact_pack.name: purchases_exact_pack
purchases_exact_pack.value: ("purchases"."pack_id" = 'creator' AND "purchases"."credits" = 1900 AND "purchases"."subtotal_usd_cents" = 1900) OR ("purchases"."pack_id" = 'pro' AND "purchases"."credits" = 4900 AND "purchases"."subtotal_usd_cents" = 4900) OR ("purchases"."pack_id" = 'studio' AND "purchases"."credits" = 9900 AND "purchases"."subtotal_usd_cents" = 9900)
